message: Post-write verification found a transcription defect in the exact Git peel f-string. The remote source used an undefined Python variable instead of a literal ^{commit} expression; correcting it to the locally validated implementation.

changes.root_cause: GitHub tree transcription dropped the doubled braces required inside the Python f-string.

evidence.summary: Corrected local implementation previously passed 5/5 tests and the deterministic self-test.
